item.title: Skiathos: Becoming a Truly Accessible Island for Everyone
item.description: Skiathos is set to become Greece’s first autism-friendly island by 2026. Partnering with Open Horizons, the municipality is creating sensory spaces, staff training and full accessibility on beaches, hotels and transport – making the island welcoming for autistic visitors and people with disabilities. item.title: The ‘Ultimate’ Tennis Record Pete Sampras Still Holds That Djokovic, Federer and Nadal Couldn’t Break
item.description: More than 25 years later, Pete Sampras still owns the record for most consecutive year-end world No. 1 finishes (1993–1998). Even with 24, 22 and 20 Grand Slams respectively, Djokovic, Nadal and Federer have never strung together more than four in a row.
